title: VPN Setup Guide for Remote Users
content:
# VPN Setup Guide

Follow these steps to configure your VPN client.

1. Download the client from company portal
2. Enter your credentials
3. Select the closest gateway
4. Click Connect

title: Phishing Awareness Training
content:
# Phishing Awareness

## How to Spot Phishing
- Check sender address carefully
- Look for generic greetings
- Don't click unexpected links
- Report to IT immediately
